_about: Morning image (lyra_image.py): BACKUP ONLY. Normally Claude designs a brand-new look every day; these lists are used only if Claude cannot answer. One outfit, one expression and one pose are picked at random. Background, art style, framing and her face always come from data/morning_base.jpg. Every pose keeps the black cat pointer stick (her signature prop). Add or remove lines freely.
